title: The Punisher
synopsis: Volition’s Marvel Punisher action game — retained as the North American PlayStation 2 retail disc published by THQ.

catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation 2 retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Complete in box. Light shelf wear consistent with age. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
The Punisher (2005) is Volition’s console and PC action adaptation of the Marvel antihero — interrogation systems, environmental kills, and a tone closer to the comics’ brutality than to a light licensed tie-in. THQ published the North American PlayStation 2 edition (SLUS-20864) in January 2005.

The shelf keeps the optical object because licensed Marvel games of this period are often reduced to checklist entries. Custody here is of the pressed disc and keep-case as they shipped for NTSC-U consoles, not of a later storefront listing.

This filing does not invent a Punisher series map across decades of adaptations. It records one complete retail edition among the PlayStation 2 action holdings.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 while expanding the PlayStation 2 physical shelf.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation 2 edition published by THQ (SLUS-20864). It remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: North American multiplatform release in January 2005; PlayStation 2 serial SLUS-20864 (commonly cited as January 17–18, 2005). Contemporary Xbox and Windows editions are neighboring objects and are not this filing.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this North American reference copy.
